import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import csv
import pathlib

import pytest

# Import the public API from the doorstop package
from doorstop import Document, Tree, importer, exporter, publisher
from doorstop.core.document import Document as DocCls
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree as TreeCls
from doorstop.core.exporter import export
from doorstop.core.publisher import publish
from doorstop.core.publishers.markdown import MarkdownPublisher


# Helper fixture to create a temporary Doorstop project
@pytest.fixture
def temp_project(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary Doorstop project directory."""
    # Create a new Tree instance pointing to the temp directory
    tree = TreeCls(tmp_path)
    # Create a root document
    doc = tree.create_document(name="root")
    return tree, doc


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(temp_project):
    """Provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text."""
    tree, doc = temp_project

    # Add a new section (item) with a title
    item = doc.add_item(level=1, reorder=False)
    item.heading = True
    item.text = "Section 1"

    # The UID should be unique and permanent (e.g., "1")
    assert item.uid is not None
    assert isinstance(item.uid, str)
    # UID should not change after reloading the document
    loaded_doc = tree.load_document(doc.path)
    loaded_item = loaded_doc.find_item(item.uid)
    assert loaded_item.uid == item.uid


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002(temp_project):
    """Support formatting within linkable text."""
    tree, doc = temp_project

    # Create a section with markdown formatting
    item = doc.add_item(level=1, reorder=False)
    item.heading = True
    item.text = "This is **bold** and *italic*"

    # The text should preserve the markdown markers
    assert "**bold**" in item.text
    assert "*italic*" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_003(temp_project):
    """Support the storage of external requirements assets."""
    tree, doc = temp_project

    # Create a dummy asset file
    asset_path = pathlib.Path(tree.path) / "external_requirements.txt"
    asset_path.write_text("Some external content")

    # Copy the asset into the project's asset directory
    doc.copy_assets([str(asset_path)])

    # The asset should now exist in the project's assets folder
    assets_dir = pathlib.Path(tree.path) / "assets"
    stored_asset = assets_dir / "external_requirements.txt"
    assert stored_asset.exists()
    assert stored_asset.read_text() == "Some external content"


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_004(temp_project):
    """Import content from other requirements management tools."""
    tree, doc = temp_project

    # Create a simple CSV file with two columns: id, text
    csv_path = pathlib.Path(tree.path) / "requirements.csv"
    with csv_path.open("w", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(["REQ1", "First requirement"])
        writer.writerow(["REQ2", "Second requirement"])

    # Import the CSV into the Doorstop project
    importer.import_file(str(csv_path), tree=tree)

    # Verify that the items were created
    loaded_doc = tree.load_document(doc.path)
    items = list(loaded_doc.items)
    assert len(items) >= 2
    texts = [i.text for i in items]
    assert "First requirement" in texts
    assert "Second requirement" in texts


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005(temp_project):
    """Export content to interact with common text/document tools."""
    tree, doc = temp_project

    # Add a sample item
    item = doc.add_item(level=1, reorder=False)
    item.heading = True
    item.text = "Exported requirement"

    # Export the document to Markdown
    output_md = pathlib.Path(tree.path) / "output.md"
    exporter.export(doc, output_md, format="markdown")

    # The output file should contain the requirement text
    assert output_md.exists()
    content = output_md.read_text()
    assert "Exported requirement" in content
    assert content.startswith("#") or content.startswith("##")  # heading marker
